Create the foundational configuration files for the QuizSnap Shopify app — a Product Recommendation Quiz Builder. Write the following files:

## 1. `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/QuizSnap/CLAUDE.md`

This is the project brain. Make it comprehensive. The app is:
- **QuizSnap** — A Shopify embedded app for building product recommendation quizzes
- Merchants create quizzes with multiple question types (multiple choice, image choice, slider, rating, text input, email capture, dropdown, date)
- Conditional branching/skip logic between questions
- Product recommendation engine that matches answers to products via tags/scoring
- Customizable results pages with product cards, discounts, add-to-cart
- Analytics dashboard (completions, drop-offs, conversion, revenue attribution)
- A/B testing for quiz variants
- Email capture with integrations (Klaviyo, Mailchimp, Omnisend)
- Storefront widget (embed, popup, slide-in, full-page)
- Theme app extension for Online Store 2.0
- Subscription billing (Free/Starter/Pro/Enterprise plans)
- Quiz templates library
- Export/import quiz data and responses

Stack:
- React Router 7 (`@shopify/shopify-app-react-router` v1) — NOT Remix
- Shopify Polaris v13 — ONLY component library
- App Bridge v4
- Prisma v6 + SQLite (dev) / PostgreSQL (prod)
- TypeScript strict
- Vite v6

Include these sections:
1. Stack (Exact Versions)
2. Folder Structure (planned)
3. Database Models (full schema — Quiz, Question, Answer, ResultPage, QuizResponse, ProductMapping, QuizTemplate, WidgetConfig, EmailIntegration, ABTest, Subscription, AnalyticsEvent, Session)
4. Route Patterns
5. Architecture Rules (auth-first, shop-scoped, loaders/actions only, Polaris only, etc.)
6. UI Rules (Polaris v13)
7. Code Rules
8. Commands reference
9. Feature Building Order checklist
10. Existing Feature Reference (start empty — will fill as we build)
11. Agent Coordination Map showing how ~50 agents work together
12. 15-Day Sprint Plan breaking down the full build

Database Schema to document in CLAUDE.md:

```
Quiz — id, shop, title, description, slug, status(draft/active/paused/archived), type(product-recommendation/personality/assessment/survey/lead-gen), settings(JSON), styling(JSON), completions, startCount, publishedAt, timestamps | unique: [shop, slug]

Question — id, quizId, type(multiple-choice/image-choice/slider/text-input/email/date/dropdown/rating), title, description, imageUrl, required, position, settings(JSON), logic(JSON), productTags(JSON) | index: [quizId, position]

Answer — id, questionId, text, imageUrl, position, score, productTags(JSON), nextQuestionId, metadata(JSON) | index: [questionId, position]

ResultPage — id, quizId, title, description, type(default/score-range/tag-match), minScore, maxScore, matchTags(JSON), productLimit, layout(grid/list/carousel), showDiscount, discountType, discountValue, discountCode, ctaText, ctaUrl, styling(JSON), position | index: [quizId]

QuizResponse — id, quizId, shop, sessionId, email, answers(JSON), score, recommendedProducts(JSON), completedAt, convertedAt, revenue, source(embed/popup/link/email), deviceType, timestamps | index: [quizId,shop], [shop,createdAt], [email]

ProductMapping — id, shop, productGid, tags(JSON), score, collections(JSON), metadata(JSON), syncedAt | unique: [shop, productGid]

QuizTemplate — id, name, description, category(skincare/fashion/food/tech/fitness/general), thumbnail, templateData(JSON), isGlobal, shop, usageCount, createdAt | index: [category], [shop]

WidgetConfig — id, shop(unique), position(embedded/popup/slide-in/full-page), triggerType(button/scroll/timer/exit-intent), triggerValue(JSON), styling(JSON), branding(JSON), customCss, timestamps

EmailIntegration — id, shop, provider(klaviyo/mailchimp/omnisend/custom-webhook), apiKey, listId, settings(JSON), isActive, timestamps | unique: [shop, provider]

ABTest — id, quizId, shop, name, status(draft/running/completed), variants(JSON), trafficSplit(JSON), winnerVariant, startedAt, endedAt, timestamps | index: [quizId], [shop]

Subscription — id, shop(unique), planId(free), billingInterval(monthly/annual), shopifySubscriptionId, status, trialEndsAt, currentPeriodEnd, quizLimit, responseLimit, timestamps

AnalyticsEvent — id, shop, quizId, eventType(quiz_started/question_answered/quiz_completed/product_clicked/added_to_cart/checkout/purchase), sessionId, data(JSON), revenue, createdAt | index: [shop,quizId,eventType], [shop,createdAt], [quizId,createdAt]

Session — Shopify OAuth (DO NOT MODIFY)
```

15-Day Sprint Plan:
- Day 1-2: Foundation (schema, auth, billing, plans, settings)
- Day 3-4: Quiz Builder CRUD (create, edit, delete, list, duplicate)
- Day 5-6: Question Builder (all 8 types, drag-drop ordering, conditional logic)
- Day 7-8: Recommendation Engine (product sync, scoring, tag matching)
- Day 9-10: Storefront Widget (theme extension, embed, popup, mobile)
- Day 11: Results Pages (product cards, discounts, add-to-cart)
- Day 12: Analytics Dashboard (metrics, charts, funnel visualization)
- Day 13: Integrations (email, A/B testing, export/import)
- Day 14: Templates Library + Onboarding
- Day 15: Performance, Testing, Deploy

## 2. `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/QuizSnap/.claude/settings.json`

Model after Pinzo's settings but for QuizSnap:
- Allow: Edit, Write, Read, npm commands, prisma commands, shopify commands, git commands, node commands, typecheck
- Deny: rm -rf, curl, wget, force push, force reset
- Auto-memory enabled
- Auto-commit hook on Stop (push to origin/main)

## 3. `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/QuizSnap/.claude/settings.local.json`

Same as Pinzo's — broad permissions for local dev, bypassPermissions mode.

Write all 3 files now. Make CLAUDE.md very comprehensive (at least 150 lines).

# QuizSnap — Project Brain

> **QuizSnap** is a Shopify embedded app for building product recommendation quizzes.
> Merchants create interactive quizzes that guide shoppers to the right products,
> capture emails, and drive conversions with personalized results pages.

---

## 1. Stack (Exact Versions)

| Layer              | Technology                                      | Version   |
| ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------- | --------- |
| Framework          | React Router (`@react-router/dev`)              | v7.12+    |
| Shopify Bridge     | `@shopify/shopify-app-react-router`             | v1.1+     |
| UI Components      | Shopify Polaris                                 | v13       |
| App Bridge         | `@shopify/app-bridge-react`                     | v4.2+     |
| ORM                | Prisma Client                                   | v6.16+    |
| DB (dev)           | SQLite                                          | file:dev.sqlite |
| DB (prod)          | PostgreSQL                                      | 15+       |
| Language           | TypeScript (strict)                             | v5.9+     |
| Bundler            | Vite                                            | v6.3+     |
| Node               | Node.js                                         | >=20.19   |
| Linting            | ESLint + Prettier                               | 8 / 3     |
| Package Manager    | npm                                             | 10+       |

---

## 3. Database Models (Prisma Schema)

### Session (Shopify OAuth — DO NOT MODIFY)
```prisma
model Session {
  id            String    @id
  shop          String
  state         String
  isOnline      Boolean   @default(false)
  scope         String?
  expires       DateTime?
  accessToken   String
  userId        BigInt?
  firstName     String?
  lastName      String?
  email         String?
  accountOwner  Boolean   @default(false)
  locale        String?
  collaborator  Boolean?  @default(false)
  emailVerified Boolean?  @default(false)
  refreshToken        String?
  refreshTokenExpires DateTime?
}
```

### Quiz
```prisma
model Quiz {
  id            String       @id @default(cuid())
  shop          String
  title         String
  description   String?
  slug          String
  status        String       @default("draft")    // draft | active | paused | archived
  type          String       @default("product-recommendation") // product-recommendation | personality | assessment | survey | lead-gen
  settings      String       @default("{}")        // JSON — general quiz settings
  styling       String       @default("{}")        // JSON — theme/colors/fonts
  completions   Int          @default(0)
  startCount    Int          @default(0)
  publishedAt   DateTime?
  createdAt     DateTime     @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime     @updatedAt

  questions     Question[]
  resultPages   ResultPage[]
  responses     QuizResponse[]
  abTests       ABTest[]
  events        AnalyticsEvent[]

  @@unique([shop, slug])
  @@index([shop])
}
```

### Question
```prisma
model Question {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  quizId      String
  type        String   // multiple-choice | image-choice | slider | text-input | email | date | dropdown | rating
  title       String
  description String?
  imageUrl    String?
  required    Boolean  @default(true)
  position    Int      @default(0)
  settings    String   @default("{}")   // JSON — type-specific settings (min/max, placeholder, etc.)
  logic       String   @default("{}")   // JSON — conditional skip/branching rules
  productTags String   @default("[]")   // JSON — tags for product matching

  quiz        Quiz     @relation(fields: [quizId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  answers     Answer[]

  @@index([quizId, position])
}
```

### Answer
```prisma
model Answer {
  id             String   @id @default(cuid())
  questionId     String
  text           String
  imageUrl       String?
  position       Int      @default(0)
  score          Int      @default(0)
  productTags    String   @default("[]")   // JSON — tags this answer maps to
  nextQuestionId String?                    // Override next question (skip logic)
  metadata       String   @default("{}")   // JSON — extra data

  question       Question @relation(fields: [questionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([questionId, position])
}
```

### ResultPage
```prisma
model ResultPage {
  id            String   @id @default(cuid())
  quizId        String
  title         String
  description   String?
  type          String   @default("default")  // default | score-range | tag-match
  minScore      Int?
  maxScore      Int?
  matchTags     String   @default("[]")       // JSON
  productLimit  Int      @default(4)
  layout        String   @default("grid")     // grid | list | carousel
  showDiscount  Boolean  @default(false)
  discountType  String?                        // percentage | fixed
  discountValue Float?
  discountCode  String?
  ctaText       String?
  ctaUrl        String?
  styling       String   @default("{}")       // JSON
  position      Int      @default(0)

  quiz          Quiz     @relation(fields: [quizId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([quizId])
}
```

### QuizResponse
```prisma
model QuizResponse {
  id                  String    @id @default(cuid())
  quizId              String
  shop                String
  sessionId           String
  email               String?
  answers             String    @default("[]")  // JSON — array of {questionId, answerId, value}
  score               Int       @default(0)
  recommendedProducts String    @default("[]")  // JSON — array of product GIDs
  completedAt         DateTime?
  convertedAt         DateTime?
  revenue             Float     @default(0)
  source              String    @default("embed") // embed | popup | link | email
  deviceType          String?                      // desktop | mobile | tablet
  createdAt           DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt           DateTime  @updatedAt

  quiz                Quiz      @relation(fields: [quizId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([quizId, shop])
  @@index([shop, createdAt])
  @@index([email])
}
```

### ProductMapping
```prisma
model ProductMapping {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  shop        String
  productGid  String                          // Shopify product GID
  tags        String   @default("[]")         // JSON — array of tags
  score       Int      @default(0)
  collections String   @default("[]")         // JSON — array of collection GIDs
  metadata    String   @default("{}")         // JSON
  syncedAt    DateTime @default(now())

  @@unique([shop, productGid])
  @@index([shop])
}
```

### QuizTemplate
```prisma
model QuizTemplate {
  id           String   @id @default(cuid())
  name         String
  description  String?
  category     String   // skincare | fashion | food | tech | fitness | general
  thumbnail    String?
  templateData String   @default("{}")  // JSON — full quiz structure
  isGlobal     Boolean  @default(false)
  shop         String?                   // null for global templates
  usageCount   Int      @default(0)
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([category])
  @@index([shop])
}
```

### WidgetConfig
```prisma
model WidgetConfig {
  id           String   @id @default(cuid())
  shop         String   @unique
  position     String   @default("embedded")   // embedded | popup | slide-in | full-page
  triggerType  String   @default("button")     // button | scroll | timer | exit-intent
  triggerValue String   @default("{}")          // JSON — trigger-specific config
  styling      String   @default("{}")          // JSON — colors, sizes, animations
  branding     String   @default("{}")          // JSON — logo, powered-by toggle
  customCss    String?
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt    DateTime @updatedAt
}
```

### EmailIntegration
```prisma
model EmailIntegration {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  shop      String
  provider  String   // klaviyo | mailchimp | omnisend | custom-webhook
  apiKey    String
  listId    String?
  settings  String   @default("{}")  // JSON — provider-specific settings
  isActive  Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  @@unique([shop, provider])
}
```

### ABTest
```prisma
model ABTest {
  id             String    @id @default(cuid())
  quizId         String
  shop           String
  name           String
  status         String    @default("draft")  // draft | running | completed
  variants       String    @default("[]")     // JSON — variant definitions
  trafficSplit   String    @default("{}")      // JSON — percentage per variant
  winnerVariant  String?
  startedAt      DateTime?
  endedAt        DateTime?
  createdAt      DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime  @updatedAt

  quiz           Quiz      @relation(fields: [quizId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([quizId])
  @@index([shop])
}
```

### Subscription
```prisma
model Subscription {
  id                     String    @id @default(cuid())
  shop                   String    @unique
  planId                 String    @default("free")
  billingInterval        String    @default("monthly")  // monthly | annual
  shopifySubscriptionId  String?
  status                 String    @default("active")
  trialEndsAt            DateTime?
  currentPeriodEnd       DateTime?
  quizLimit              Int       @default(1)
  responseLimit          Int       @default(100)
  createdAt              DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt              DateTime  @updatedAt
}
```

### AnalyticsEvent
```prisma
model AnalyticsEvent {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  shop      String
  quizId    String
  eventType String   // quiz_started | question_answered | quiz_completed | product_clicked | added_to_cart | checkout | purchase
  sessionId String
  data      String   @default("{}")  // JSON — event-specific payload
  revenue   Float    @default(0)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  quiz      Quiz     @relation(fields: [quizId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([shop, quizId, eventType])
  @@index([shop, createdAt])
  @@index([quizId, createdAt])
}
```

## 4. Route Patterns

All authenticated app routes follow the `app.*` prefix pattern. The `app.tsx` layout wraps them with Polaris `AppProvider` + `Frame` + navigation.

| Route File                        | URL Path                     | Purpose                          |
| --------------------------------- | ---------------------------- | -------------------------------- |
| `app.tsx`                         | `/app`                       | Authenticated layout (Frame)     |
| `app._index.tsx`                  | `/app`                       | Dashboard home                   |
| `app.quizzes.tsx`                 | `/app/quizzes`               | Quiz list                        |
| `app.quizzes.new.tsx`             | `/app/quizzes/new`           | Create new quiz                  |
| `app.quizzes.$id.tsx`             | `/app/quizzes/:id`           | Quiz builder / editor            |
| `app.quizzes.$id.questions.tsx`   | `/app/quizzes/:id/questions` | Question editor                  |
| `app.quizzes.$id.results.tsx`     | `/app/quizzes/:id/results`   | Results page editor              |
| `app.quizzes.$id.logic.tsx`       | `/app/quizzes/:id/logic`     | Skip logic / branching           |
| `app.quizzes.$id.preview.tsx`     | `/app/quizzes/:id/preview`   | Live quiz preview                |
| `app.quizzes.$id.analytics.tsx`   | `/app/quizzes/:id/analytics` | Per-quiz analytics               |
| `app.analytics.tsx`               | `/app/analytics`             | Global analytics dashboard       |
| `app.templates.tsx`               | `/app/templates`             | Template library                 |
| `app.integrations.tsx`            | `/app/integrations`          | Email integrations               |

| `app.export.tsx`                  | `/app/export`                | Export / import                  |

### Route Rules
- **Loaders** fetch data; **Actions** mutate data. No inline DB queries in components.
- Every `loader`/`action` starts with `await authenticate.admin(request)` (or `authenticate.public.appProxy` for public routes).
- All data is **shop-scoped** — every query filters by `shop`.
- Return `json()` from loaders; redirect or return `json()` from actions.

---

## 5. Architecture Rules

1. **Auth-first**: Every loader/action must authenticate before doing anything.
2. **Shop-scoped**: All database queries MUST include a `shop` filter. Never leak data across shops.
3. **Server-only data access**: All Prisma calls live in `*.server.ts` files. Never import Prisma on the client.
4. **Loaders/Actions only**: No `useEffect` fetching. All data flows through React Router loaders and actions.
5. **Polaris only**: The ONLY UI component library is `@shopify/polaris` v13. No Tailwind, no Material UI, no custom CSS frameworks.
6. **App Bridge v4**: Use `@shopify/app-bridge-react` for navigation, toasts, modals, resource pickers.
7. **Billing gate**: Features behind paid plans check `Subscription` model before rendering.
8. **JSON columns**: Since SQLite has no native JSON type, all JSON fields are stored as `String` and parsed with `JSON.parse()` / `JSON.stringify()`.
9. **Cascading deletes**: When a Quiz is deleted, all Questions, Answers, ResultPages, Responses, ABTests, and Events cascade-delete.
10. **No external CSS**: All styling goes through Polaris component props or the `styling` JSON fields for storefront widgets.

---

## 6. UI Rules (Polaris v13)

1. **Page structure**: Every page uses `<Page>` with `title`, `primaryAction`, and optional `secondaryActions`.
2. **Layout**: Use `<Layout>` with `<Layout.Section>` and `<Layout.Section variant="oneThird">` for sidebars.
3. **Cards**: Wrap content in `<Card>`. Use `<BlockStack gap="400">` inside cards for spacing.
4. **Forms**: Use `<Form>` + `<FormLayout>` for form pages. Submit through React Router `<Form method="post">`.
5. **Tables**: Use `<IndexTable>` for list pages with bulk actions. Use `<DataTable>` for analytics.
6. **Loading**: Use `<SkeletonPage>` / `<SkeletonBodyText>` while data loads in navigation.
7. **Empty states**: Always provide `<EmptyState>` with illustration and CTA for empty lists.
8. **Toasts**: Use App Bridge `useToast()` for success/error feedback after actions.
9. **Modals**: Use App Bridge `<Modal>` for confirmations and lightweight forms.
10. **Navigation**: Define nav in `app.tsx` layout using `<ui-nav-menu>` App Bridge component.
11. **Icons**: Import from `@shopify/polaris-icons`. Do not use other icon libraries.
12. **Responsive**: Polaris handles responsiveness. Do not add custom media queries.
13. **Color tokens**: Use Polaris design tokens, never hardcode colors in admin UI.

---

## 7. Code Rules

1. **TypeScript strict mode**: `strict: true` in `tsconfig.json`. No `any` types without justification.
2. **Naming conventions**:
   - Files: `kebab-case.ts` / `kebab-case.tsx`
   - Components: `PascalCase`
   - Functions/variables: `camelCase`
   - Constants: `UPPER_SNAKE_CASE`
   - Types/Interfaces: `PascalCase`
3. **Imports**: Absolute imports via `~/*` alias (configured in tsconfig paths).
4. **Server files**: Suffix with `.server.ts` — never import these in client components.
5. **Validation**: Use Zod for all input validation in actions.
6. **Error handling**: Wrap loader/action bodies in try/catch. Return structured error responses.
7. **No `console.log` in production**: Use structured logging or remove before commit.
8. **Prisma transactions**: Use `prisma.$transaction()` for multi-step mutations.
9. **Type exports**: Export types from `app/types/` — co-locate if only used in one file.
10. **No barrel exports**: Import directly from the source file, not `index.ts` barrels.

---

## 8. Commands Reference

```bash
# Development
npm run dev                  # Start dev server (Shopify CLI)
npm run build                # Production build
npm run start                # Serve production build
npm run typecheck             # Run TypeScript typegen + type check

# Database
npx prisma generate          # Generate Prisma client
npx prisma migrate dev       # Create + apply dev migration
npx prisma migrate deploy    # Apply migrations (prod)
npx prisma studio            # Open Prisma Studio GUI
npx prisma db push           # Push schema without migration (dev only)

# Shopify
npm run shopify              # Shopify CLI
shopify app dev              # Dev server with tunnel
shopify app deploy           # Deploy app + extensions
shopify app generate extension  # Generate new extension

# Code Quality
npm run lint                 # ESLint
npx prettier --write .       # Format all files

# Setup
npm run setup                # prisma generate + migrate deploy
npm run docker-start         # Setup + start (Docker)
```
